h2: NDT training in Kansas: options across the state compared
html:
NDT training in Kansas: options across the state compared

Kansas is unusual among plains states: it has a full college NDT programme, in Wichita, built around the aircraft industry. That makes the choice simpler for a newcomer near Wichita and harder for everyone else, because the refinery towns, gas fields, wind farms and Kansas City plants are a long drive from it. This section sets the options side by side.

Who offers NDT training around Kansas?

  • WSU Tech, Wichita. Offers an Associate of Applied Science and a Technical Certificate in nondestructive testing, plus shorter certificates of completion in radiography, ultrasonic, eddy current, magnetic particle and penetrant work. The college describes the programme as working toward ASNT Level I and II competencies in six methods, with hands-on aerospace assembly, and runs it with the National Institute for Aviation Research. It is the most complete campus option in the region. It is a college credential, not certification; an employer still certifies you after you log experience hours.
  • Kansas City area welding programmes. Johnson County Community College and Kansas City Kansas Community College both run welding programmes. Expect visual weld inspection within welding; ask whether any course introduces PT or MT before counting it as NDT training.
  • Aerospace manufacturers and MRO shops. The Wichita aerostructures, business-jet and maintenance employers train and certify their own inspectors, often to the inspection standard their customers specify.
  • Refinery, pipeline and oilfield service contractors. In El Dorado, McPherson, Coffeyville and the western gas fields, inspection contractors hire helpers and certify them under their own written practice.
  • Self-paced online theory with the practical at work. The realistic route for technicians in Hays, Garden City, Liberal or Salina.

Which route fits you?

Your situationRoute that usually fitsWhat to check
Starting out near Wichita, no NDT job yetThe WSU Tech certificate or degreeProgramme length, which methods you finish with, employer links
Starting out in western or central KansasA trainee role with an oilfield or pipeline contractorThat your supervised hours are recorded by method
Working technician adding UT, MT or PTA self-paced method course and a practical at your facilityThat the hours meet your written practice for that method
Employer certifying a crewOn-site training at the plant, yard or hangarCustomer flow-down requirements and who administers the exams

Aircraft work versus energy work

The two halves of the state train for different jobs. Wichita aerospace inspection leans on penetrant testing of machined parts, ultrasonic testing of bonded and composite structure and eddy current on fastener holes, and customers often specify their own inspection standard on top of the employer's procedures. Refinery, pipeline and gas-plant work leans on UT thickness, weld inspection with UT and MT, and visual inspection during turnarounds, usually under an SNT-TC-1A written practice. Choose the method you study by the employer you are aiming at; a first method that suits a hangar may not be the one a pipeline contractor needs.

Questions to ask any NDT training provider in Kansas

  1. How many documented hours does each method and level give, and how do they compare with SNT-TC-1A?
  2. Will the practical use parts like mine: aluminum structure, composite panels, castings, piping or pipeline welds?
  3. Who certifies me? Under SNT-TC-1A it is the employer; a course or degree is evidence of training.
  4. Will my employer's Level III accept these hours under the company written practice?
  5. Is there a Level III to answer questions while I study?

Kansas is an NRC Agreement State. Radioactive materials licences for industrial radiography are issued by the Radiation Control Program of the Kansas Department of Health and Environment; training in RT theory does not by itself allow anyone to work with sources.

Where Atlantis fits for Kansas candidates and employers

Atlantis NDT has no classroom in Kansas. Theory is self-paced on the Atlantis portal, available from the day you enrol, with question-and-answer support from an ASNT NDT Level III in UT, RT, MT, PT and VT. Practice runs in the Practical NDT simulator, and the hands-on practical is completed at your employer's facility under a written practice built on SNT-TC-1A; crews can be trained on-site. See Level 1 training, Level 2 training and the ultrasonic testing course, then confirm your hours with the eligibility checker. For more local detail read the Wichita and Kansas City pages, and fabrication inspectors can look at AWS CWI exam prep from Wichita.
